actors.role: Prime Minister of Hungary, Leader of Tisza Party
actors.blurb: Péter Magyar has rapidly become a defining figure in Hungary's political discourse, particularly due to his handling of the country's energy and water crises. His announcements regarding the stabilization of Hungary's energy supply and the end of voluntary consumption cuts have been central to recent coverage. Magyar's criticisms of the previous Orbán government's energy policies and his plans for an 'energy revolution' have further solidified his role as a key actor in Hungary's current political climate.
